question: Using the same RBAC-action-level results as before, produce a report that lists each RBAC action (suppressing repeated action values on consecutive rows), the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of subnet IP versions for DHCP-enabled subnets on non-shared networks (excluding networks that have an `access_as_shared` RBAC entry targeting `'*'` or `9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b`, and only keeping actions with more than 5 matching subnets), the variance of subnet IP versions for publicly shared `access_as_shared` RBAC entries (target tenant `'*'`), and also the total number of distinct subnet tenants contributing to each action’s DHCP-enabled/non-shared calculation. Include a final TOTAL row across all actions. Do not return any rounded answers.

prediction.sql:
WITH
excl AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT object_id
  FROM networkrbacs
  WHERE action = 'access_as_shared'
    AND target_tenant IN ('*', '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b')
),
base AS (
  SELECT
    r.action,
    s.ip_version,
    s.tenant_id,
    s.id AS subnet_id
  FROM networkrbacs r
  JOIN networks n ON n.id = r.object_id
  JOIN subnets s ON s.network_id = n.id
  WHERE s.enable_dhcp = 1
    AND n.id NOT IN (SELECT object_id FROM excl)
),
action_stats AS (
  SELECT
    action,
    STDDEV(ip_version) AS ip_version_stddev,
    COUNT(DISTINCT tenant_id) AS distinct_subnet_tenants
  FROM base
  GROUP BY action
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT subnet_id) > 5
),
shared_variance AS (
  SELECT
    r.action,
    VARIANCE(s.ip_version) AS shared_ip_version_variance
  FROM networkrbacs r
  JOIN networks n ON n.id = r.object_id
  JOIN subnets s ON s.network_id = n.id
  WHERE r.action = 'access_as_shared'
    AND r.target_tenant = '*'
  GROUP BY r.action
),
final AS (
  SELECT
    a.action,
    a.ip_version_stddev,
    sv.shared_ip_version_variance,
    a.distinct_subnet_tenants,
    1 AS row_order
  FROM action_stats a
  LEFT JOIN shared_variance sv ON a.action = sv.action
),
total AS (
  SELECT
    'TOTAL' AS action,
    STDDEV(b.ip_version) AS ip_version_stddev,
    (SELECT VARIANCE(s.ip_version)
     FROM networkrbacs r
     JOIN networks n ON n.id = r.object_id
     JOIN subnets s ON s.network_id = n.id
     WHERE r.action = 'access_as_shared'
       AND r.target_tenant = '*') AS shared_ip_version_variance,
    COUNT(DISTINCT b.tenant_id) AS distinct_subnet_tenants,
    2 AS row_order
  FROM base b
),
combined AS (
  SELECT action, ip_version_stddev, shared_ip_version_variance, distinct_subnet_tenants, row_order FROM final
  UNION ALL
  SELECT action, ip_version_stddev, shared_ip_version_variance, distinct_subnet_tenants, row_order FROM total

  SELECT

    ip_version_stddev,

WITH
excl AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT object_id
  FROM networkrbacs
  WHERE action = 'access_as_shared'
    AND target_tenant IN ('*', '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b')
),
base AS (
  SELECT
    r.action,
    s.ip_version,
    s.tenant_id,
    s.id AS subnet_id
  FROM networkrbacs r
  JOIN networks n ON n.id = r.object_id
  JOIN subnets s ON s.network_id = n.id
  WHERE s.enable_dhcp = 1
    AND n.id NOT IN (SELECT object_id FROM excl)
),
action_stats AS (
  SELECT
    action,
    STDDEV(ip_version) AS ip_version_stddev,
    COUNT(DISTINCT tenant_id) AS distinct_subnet_tenants
  FROM base
  GROUP BY action
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT subnet_id) > 5
),
shared_variance AS (
  SELECT
    r.action,
    VARIANCE(s.ip_version) AS shared_ip_version_variance
  FROM networkrbacs r
  JOIN networks n ON n.id = r.object_id
  JOIN subnets s ON s.network_id = n.id
  WHERE r.action = 'access_as_shared'
    AND r.target_tenant = '*'
  GROUP BY r.action
),
final AS (
  SELECT
    a.action,
    a.ip_version_stddev,
    sv.shared_ip_version_variance,
    a.distinct_subnet_tenants,
    1 AS row_order
  FROM action_stats a
  LEFT JOIN shared_variance sv ON a.action = sv.action
),
total AS (
  SELECT
    'TOTAL' AS action,
    STDDEV(b.ip_version) AS ip_version_stddev,
    (SELECT VARIANCE(s.ip_version)
     FROM networkrbacs r
     JOIN networks n ON n.id = r.object_id
     JOIN subnets s ON s.network_id = n.id
     WHERE r.action = 'access_as_shared'
       AND r.target_tenant = '*') AS shared_ip_version_variance,
    COUNT(DISTINCT b.tenant_id) AS distinct_subnet_tenants,
    2 AS row_order
  FROM base b
),
combined AS (
  SELECT action, ip_version_stddev, shared_ip_version_variance, distinct_subnet_tenants, row_order FROM final
  UNION ALL
  SELECT action, ip_version_stddev, shared_ip_version_variance, distinct_subnet_tenants, row_order FROM total
),
with_lag AS (
  SELECT
    action,
    ip_version_stddev,
    shared_ip_version_variance,
    distinct_subnet_tenants,
    row_order,
    LAG(action) OVER (ORDER BY row_order, action) AS prev_action
  FROM combined
)
SELECT
  CASE WHEN prev_action = action THEN NULL ELSE action END AS action,
  ip_version_stddev,
  shared_ip_version_variance,
  distinct_subnet_tenants
FROM with_lag
ORDER BY row_order, action

WITH
excl AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT object_id
  FROM networkrbacs
  WHERE action = 'access_as_shared'
    AND target_tenant IN ('*', '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b')
),
base AS (
  SELECT
    r.action,
    s.ip_version,
    s.tenant_id,
    s.id AS subnet_id
  FROM networkrbacs r
  JOIN networks n ON n.id = r.object_id
  JOIN subnets s ON s.network_id = n.id
  WHERE s.enable_dhcp = 1
    AND n.id NOT IN (SELECT object_id FROM excl)
),
action_stats AS (
  SELECT
    action,
    STDDEV(ip_version) AS ip_version_stddev,
    COUNT(DISTINCT tenant_id) AS distinct_subnet_tenants
  FROM base
  GROUP BY action
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT subnet_id) > 5
),
shared_variance AS (
  SELECT
    r.action,
    VARIANCE(s.ip_version) AS shared_ip_version_variance
  FROM networkrbacs r
  JOIN networks n ON n.id = r.object_id
  JOIN subnets s ON s.network_id = n.id
  WHERE r.action = 'access_as_shared'
    AND r.target_tenant = '*'
  GROUP BY r.action
),
final AS (
  SELECT
    a.action,
    a.ip_version_stddev,
    sv.shared_ip_version_variance,
    a.distinct_subnet_tenants,
    1 AS row_order
  FROM action_stats a
  LEFT JOIN shared_variance sv ON a.action = sv.action
),
total AS (
  SELECT
    'TOTAL' AS action,
    STDDEV(b.ip_version) AS ip_version_stddev,
    (SELECT VARIANCE(s.ip_version)
     FROM networkrbacs r
     JOIN networks n ON n.id = r.object_id
     JOIN subnets s ON s.network_id = n.id
     WHERE r.action = 'access_as_shared'
       AND r.target_tenant = '*') AS shared_ip_version_variance,
    COUNT(DISTINCT b.tenant_id) AS distinct_subnet_tenants,
    2 AS row_order
  FROM base b
),
combined AS (
  SELECT action, ip_version_stddev, shared_ip_version_variance, distinct_subnet_tenants, row_order FROM final
  UNION ALL
  SELECT action, ip_version_stddev, shared_ip_version_variance, distinct_subnet_tenants, row_order FROM total
),
with_lag AS (
  SELECT
    action,
    ip_version_stddev,
    shared_ip_version_variance,
    distinct_subnet_tenants,
    row_order,
    LAG(action) OVER (ORDER BY row_order, action) AS prev_action
  FROM combined
)
SELECT
  CASE WHEN prev_action = action THEN NULL ELSE action END AS action,
  ip_version_stddev,
  shared_ip_version_variance,
  distinct_subnet_tenants
FROM with_lag
ORDER BY row_order, action

WITH
excl AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT object_id
  FROM networkrbacs
  WHERE action='access_as_shared' AND target_tenant IN ('*','9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b')
),
base AS (
  SELECT r.action, s.ip_version, s.tenant_id
  FROM networkrbacs r
  JOIN networks n ON n.id = r.object_id
  JOIN subnets s ON s.network_id = n.id
  WHERE s.enable_dhcp = 1
    AND n.id NOT IN (SELECT object_id FROM excl)
),
agg AS (
  SELECT action,
         STDDEV(ip_version) AS sd,
         COUNT(DISTINCT tenant_id) AS distinct_tenants
  FROM base
  GROUP BY action
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 5
),
pub AS (
  SELECT r.action,
         VARIANCE(s.ip_version) AS var
  FROM networkrbacs r
  JOIN networks n ON n.id = r.object_id
  JOIN subnets s ON s.network_id = n.id
  WHERE r.action='access_as_shared' AND r.target_tenant='*'
  GROUP BY r.action
),
rows AS (
  SELECT a.action,
         a.sd,
         p.var,
         a.distinct_tenants,
         1 AS ord
  FROM agg a
  LEFT JOIN pub p ON p.action = a.action
),
tot AS (
  SELECT 'TOTAL' AS action,
         STDDEV(b.ip_version) AS sd,
         VARIANCE(p2.ip_version) AS var,
         COUNT(DISTINCT b.tenant_id) AS distinct_tenants,
         2 AS ord
  FROM base b
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT s.ip_version
    FROM networkrbacs r
    JOIN networks n ON n.id = r.object_id
    JOIN subnets s ON s.network_id = n.id
    WHERE r.action='access_as_shared' AND r.target_tenant='*'
  ) p2 ON 1=0
)
SELECT action, sd, var, distinct_tenants
FROM (
  SELECT * FROM rows
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM tot
) t
ORDER BY ord, action;
